resources.string: Converts a Stable Diffusion 1.5 checkpoint into a Qualcomm NPU model on this phone. About two minutes.

Conversion replaces the UNet only. The VAE and text encoder come from DreamShaper, so colour and prompt interpretation follow the template rather than this checkpoint.

LoRAs are merged into the weights, so they cost nothing at generation time — but each combination is its own model. The text-encoder half is not applied, so style LoRAs work better than trigger-word ones.
Leave the screen on. The compile needs several gigabytes and Android may stop it otherwise.
Saved to %1$s. Import it in your generator as a custom model.
The text encoder and VAE come from DreamShaper, not from your checkpoint: conversion covers the UNet, which is what carries style and subject. Prompt interpretation and colour follow the template.
Needs a realistic SD1.5 checkpoint of about 2 GB, and roughly 4 GB of free storage while it works. Anime checkpoints are untested.
